description.en: Local subprocess that bridges Semantica into Multica. Phase 2 adds the semantica_decision_advisor agent (delegatable via `multica lab delegate semantica`), terminal-issue decision sync (POST /api/decisions), and a Labs-tab iframe at /experimental/semantica-explorer. Phase 1 catalog + REST bridge + curl skill still apply. Off by default.
description.zh: 本地子进程,把 Semantica 桥接到 Multica。Phase 2 新增 semantica_decision_advisor agent(`multica lab delegate semantica` 可委托)、终态 issue 自动同步决策(POST /api/decisions)、Labs 标签页 iframe(/experimental/semantica-explorer)。Phase 1 catalog + REST 桥接 + curl技能仍生效。默认关闭。

runtime.on_missing: service not bundled — install Semantica (pip install -e $SEMANTICA_REPO_PATH) and set SEMANTICA_REPO_PATH in the desktop env
